name: unsafe fn split_at_mut_unchecked (self , mid : usize) -> (* mut [T] , * mut [T])
rule: For safety, `self` must span a single allocation at least `mid * size_of::<T>()` bytes long when calling `split_at_mut_unchecked`, so that `mid` is in-bounds of the underlying allocated object; this requirement applies even if the resulting pointers are not used.
api: impl < T > * mut [T] { unsafe fn split_at_mut_unchecked (self , mid : usize) -> (* mut [T] , * mut [T]) }
